primary_source_candidates.author: Mathieu Lewin
primary_source_candidates.title: Coulomb and Riesz gases: The known and the unknown
primary_source_candidates.relevant_locations: PDF pages 1-3, 41-43, 58-59; definitions (1)-(3), Conjectures 35 and 38, Section VI
primary_source_candidates.findings: Defines d-dimensional Riesz potentials V_s, with s in (-2,infinity) and inverse temperature beta; long-range s<=d needs renormalization. Conjecture 35 is zero-temperature energy and Conjecture 38 is zero-temperature configurations, not a finite-temperature crystal theorem. Section VI describes finite-beta phase transition through nonunique Riesz point processes and periodic pure states; the author knew a proof only for s=-1,d=1 in 2022.
